D: A Memphis family takes in a homeless teenager who goes on to become a star football player.
P: Serve the main when Leigh Anne switches off the football and gets everyone to the table.
S: Wings rubbed with smoked paprika, brown sugar and garlic, baked crisp and served with a tangy mustard barbecue sauce. Mix 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp salt. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and the rub. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Mix 150ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp American mustard and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for dipping.

Southern devilled eggs with a creamy mustard and pickle filling, topped with crisp bacon, smoked paprika and chives. Cook 8 eggs in boiling water for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Halve and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp American mustard, 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles and salt. Pipe back into the whites. Grill 3 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Top the eggs with bacon, a dusting of smoked paprika and chives.
M: Tuohy Thanksgiving turkey at the table
the Thanksgiving Michael eats at the table

Herb roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing, creamy mash, buttery green beans, gravy and cranberry sauce. Push 60g herb butter under the skin of a 1.5kg turkey breast and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Crumble 300g cornbread with 1 fried onion, 2 celery sticks, chopped sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with butter and milk. Blanch 300g green beans and toss in butter. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
W: the story Leigh Anne reads at bedtime

A sticky golden syrup and brown sugar pecan pie in a crisp pastry case, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and bake blind at 190C for 12 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 150ml golden syrup, 50g melted butter, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Stir in 200g pecans. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool 1 hour and serve with ice cream.
K: a Memphis afternoon with the Tuohys

Black tea brewed strong and sweet, chilled with peach and lemon and poured over ice with fresh mint. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 120g sugar for 5 minutes. Remove the bags, cool and chill. Stir in 300ml peach nectar and the juice of 1 lemon. Fill 4 glasses with ice and peach slices, pour over the tea and finish with mint sprigs and lemon wheels.
